description: This file defines an abstract test runner class for fault testing of Orleans transactions, including methods to test transaction abortion on exceptions, read-only violations, nested transaction failures, and orphan calls.

classes.name: GrainFaultTransactionTestRunner
classes.description: An abstract class providing methods to run fault injection tests on Orleans transactions, including scenarios like exceptions, read-only violations, and orphan calls.

methods.name: AbortTransactionOnExceptions
methods.description: Tests that transactions are aborted correctly when exceptions are thrown during coordinator operations.

methods.name: AbortTransactionOnReadOnlyViolatedException
methods.description: Tests that transactions are aborted when a read-only violated exception occurs.

methods.name: MultiGrainAbortTransactionOnExceptions
methods.description: Tests aborting transactions involving multiple grains when an exception occurs.

methods.name: AbortTransactionExceptionInnerExceptionOnlyContainsOneRootCauseException
methods.description: Checks that the inner exception chain of an abort transaction contains only one root cause exception.

methods.name: AbortTransactionOnOrphanCalls
methods.description: Tests that orphaned calls correctly trigger transaction aborts.

methods.name: TestAfterDustSettles
methods.description: Retries a given asynchronous test sequence to handle cascading aborts due to optimistic concurrency issues.
